The Utojis Shrine can be found in the Tobio's Hollow Cave in East Necluda. It corresponds to the Sijotu Lightroot in the Depths.
solution_zh:
乌托之神殿是一个简单的圣光，其唯一目的就是奖励链接到达此地。它只有一个路径，位于一个空旷区域，只有一块石箱标记着。

在乌托之神殿的尽头，可以找到拉鲁和索尼亚的雕像。通过与雕像前的终端互动，链接可以获得“祝福之光”，从而净化自己内心的黑暗。

乌托之神殿位于东尼克鲁达地区的托比洞穴中。它对应于深渊中的西朱特之根。

solution_en: The Kamizun Shrine is a Shrine of Light that can be found within the Forest of Time in Hyrule Field. It corresponds to the Nuzimak Lightroot in the Depths.
solution_zh: 卡米津神社是位于海拉鲁平原的时之森林中的圣光之地。它与深处的努齐马克光根对应。

solution_en:
The Suariwak Shrine is a simple Shrine of Light with the sole purpose of rewarding Link for reaching it. It bears a lone pathway in a void marked only by a Stone Chest.
A Rauru and Sonia Statue can be found at the end of Suariwak Shrine. By interacting with the Terminal in front of the Statue, Link can receive a Light of Blessing to cleanse the corruption of Darkness from within him.

The Suariwak Shrine can be found in the back room of the Yiga Blademaster Station in the Gerudo Highlands. It corresponds with the Kawiraus Lightroot in the Depths. Link is able to access the Shrine of Light by completing "The Yiga Clan Exam" Side Adventure, at which point the Yiga Blademaster will allow him to access the room it is located in.
solution_zh:
苏瓦里克神殿是一个简单的光之圣殿，其唯一目的在于奖励链接到达这里。它只有一个通道，位于一个空旷区域，只有一块石箱。

在苏瓦里克神殿的尽头可以找到拉鲁和索尼亚的雕像。通过与雕像前的终端互动，链接可以获得“祝福之光”，从而净化自己内心的黑暗。

苏瓦里克神殿位于格鲁多高原的“义家剑术训练营”后面的房间里。它对应于深渊中的“卡维拉斯的光根”。通过完成“义家氏族考试”的支线任务，链接可以进入这个圣殿，义家剑术训练营的负责人会允许他进入该房间。

solution_en:
The Rakakudaj Shrine is a simple Shrine of Light with the sole purpose of rewarding Link for reaching it. It bears a lone pathway in a void marked only by a Stone Chest.
A Rauru and Sonia Statue can be found at the end of Rakakudaj Shrine. By interacting with the Terminal in front of the Statue, Link can receive a Light of Blessing to cleanse the corruption of Darkness from within him.

The Rakakudaj Shrine is situated in the center of the Gerudo Canyon. It corresponds with the Jadukakar Lightroot in the Depths. Initially, the Shrine of Light has no entrance, although its Travel Point can be activated. As part of "The Gerudo Canyon Crystal" Shrine Quest, Link must bring a Mysterious Crystal up the Canyon's river to the Travel Point. Once he does so, it will grow in size and become the Shrine's entrance.
solution_zh:
拉卡库达什神殿是一个简单的光之神殿，其唯一目的就是奖励链接到达这里。它只有一个通道，位于一片空地，只有一块石头箱子作为标记。

在拉卡库达什神殿的尽头，可以找到一个代表拉鲁和索尼亚的雕像。通过与雕像前的终端互动，链接可以获得“祝福之光”，用于净化他体内黑暗的侵蚀。

拉卡库达什神殿位于格鲁多峡谷的中心。它与深渊中的贾德卡尔光根相对应。最初，神殿没有入口，但可以通过激活旅行点进入。作为“格鲁多峡谷水晶”神殿任务的一部分，链接需要将一个神秘的水晶运上峡谷河道到旅行点。一旦完成，水晶会变大并成为神殿的入口。

solution_en: The Rasitakiwak Shrine can be found along the southern portion of the Kaepora Pass in the Akkala Highlands. It corresponds to the Kawikatisar Lightroot in the Depths.
solution_zh: 拉西塔基瓦克神殿位于阿卡拉高原南部，卡伊波拉通道。它与深渊中的卡维凯塔尔光根对应。

solution_en: The Zakusu Shrine is located on the Naydra Snowfield on the western side of Mount Lanayru. It corresponds to the Usukaz Lightroot in the Depths.
solution_zh: 扎库苏神社位于拉奈鲁山的西侧纳伊德拉雪原上。它对应于深渊中的乌苏卡之光根。

solution_en: The Simosiwak Shrine is situated on Bravery Island in the Great Hyrule Forest Sky.
solution_zh: 西摩斯瓦克神殿位于广袤的海拉尔森林天空中的“勇气岛”。

solution_en:
Yansamin Shrine is composed of three chambers, with the middle chamber acting as an arena for Link to fight against Construct Enemies. As Link enters the Shrine, he will be stripped of all of his equipment and challenged to defeat the Enemies inside. As part of this challenge, the interior of the Shrine is affected by a low Gravity.
On the ground floor, there is an entry hall that provides equipment for Link to fight with. Near this hall, there is a set of platforms leading up to an isolated second level. To the right of these platforms, there is a mechanism in the floor that retracts and pushes upward. Above this mechanism, there is a hollow column blocked by a Cracked Floor Tile. Further away from the entrance from this mechanism, there is another platform with a disjointed ramp leading up to it.

Atop this platform, there are a Spiked Iron Ball and four Bomb Barrels. These Bomb Barrels can be used with the aforementioned mechanism to break the Cracked Floor Tile, creating a lift to the highest level. To the left of this ramped platform, there is an Ascending platform that rises and falls between the second and third levels. The third level is populated by several Constructs and Bomb Barrels.

When Link defeats all of the Enemies, the mysterious voice tells him that his equipment will be returned to him. After this, the portcullis blocking the rear chamber will lift, allowing Link to reach the Rauru and Sonia Statue. By interacting with the Terminal in front of the Statue, Link can receive a Light of Blessing to cleanse the corruption of Darkness from within him.

Yansamin Shrine is a Shrine of Light located inside Zonaite Forge Island in the East Necluda Sky. It can only be accessed by Skydiving from the top of the Island after activating the Terminal on its northeastern base.
solution_zh:
雅南神殿由三个房间组成，中间的房间是林克与构造敌人战斗的场所。当林克进入神殿时，他会失去所有装备，并被要求击败里面的敌人。作为这个挑战的一部分，神殿内部受到低重力的影响。

在地面层，有一个入口大厅，提供林克用来战斗的装备。在大厅附近，有一组平台通往一个独立的二楼。在这些平台的右侧，有一个可以收回并向上推的装置。该装置上方，有一个被破碎的地板砖所阻挡的空柱。远离入口的地方，还有一个带有倾斜坡的平台。

在该平台上，有 spiked iron球和四个炸弹箱。可以通过上述装置来破坏破碎的地板砖，从而创建一个连接到最高楼层的升降机制。在倾斜平台的左侧，有一个向上和向下移动的平台，该平台位于二楼和三楼之间。第三层由几个构造人和炸弹箱组成。

当林克击败所有敌人时，神秘的声音告诉他他的装备将会归还。之后，阻挡后殿的大门会打开，允许林克到达拉鲁和索尼娅的雕像。通过与雕像前的终端互动，林克可以获得“祝福之光”，从而净化自身内的黑暗。

雅南神殿是位于东部内克鲁达天空中的Zonaite Forge岛内的光明神殿。只有从岛屿顶部的入口跳伞后，并在其东北部基座处激活终端时，才能进入该神殿。

solution_en: The Jojon Shrine is situated within the Crenel Peak Cave in Hyrule Field. It corresponds with the Nojoj Lightroot in the Depths.
solution_zh: “ジョジョン神社”位于“クレーネル峰”洞穴内，与“深渊中的ノジョジョ光根”对应。

solution_en: The Sifumim Shrine is located on a cliff northwest of Lurelin Village in East Necluda. It corresponds to the Mimufis Lightroot in the Depths.
solution_zh: 西夫米神殿位于东尼克卢达的鲁瑞林村西北悬崖上。它与深渊中的米穆菲斯光根对应。

solution_en:
The Otak Shrine is a combat Shrine of Light built around a variety of traps. Upon entry, Link's Inventory is removed. The objective of the Shrine is to use the traps found within to defeat all the Constructs inside.

The Otak Shrine is situated within the Icefall Foothills Cave in the Hebra Mountains. It corresponds with the Kato Lightroot in the Depths.
solution_zh:
奥塔神殿是一个以陷阱为中心的战斗型圣殿。进入后，Link的物品栏将被移除。神殿的目标是利用其中的陷阱击败内部的所有敌人。

奥塔神殿位于赫布拉山脉的冰瀑山麓洞穴中，与深渊中的 Kato 光根相对应。

solution_en: The Miryotanog Shrine is situated on a hill in the Toruma Dunes, which is located in the western Gerudo Desert. It corresponds to the Gonatoyrim Lightroot in the Depths.
solution_zh: 米里奥塔诺神殿位于托鲁玛沙丘，该沙丘位于西部的格鲁多沙漠。它与深渊中的冈纳托里姆光根对应。

solution_en: The Kimayat Shrine can be found at Gut Check Rock in the northeastern corner of Eldin Canyon. It corresponds with the Tayamik Lightroot in the Depths.
solution_zh: 金玛特神庙位于埃尔丁峡谷东北部的“Gut Check Rock”上。它与深渊中的“Tayamik Lightroot”对应。

solution_en:
The Momosik Shrine is a simple Shrine of Light with the sole purpose of rewarding Link for reaching it. It bears a lone pathway in a void marked only by a Stone Chest.
A Rauru and Sonia Statue can be found at the end of Momosik Shrine. By interacting with the Terminal in front of the Statue, Link can receive a Light of Blessing to cleanse the corruption of Darkness from within him.

The Momosik Shrine can be found on the eastern side of Death Caldera in Eldin Canyon. It corresponds with the Kisomom Lightroot in the Depths.

solution_en:
The entrance to Teniten Shrine opens into a spacious room with a raised half-pipe platform. To the left of the entrance is a rack stocked with five Rusty Halberds. When Link approaches the platform, a Training Construct atop it will awaken and a Mysterious Voice will speak to him. The Voice instructs him to throw a Weapon at the Training Construct. The Training Construct will then periodically take shots at Link with its Construct Bow.
As the Mysterious Voice warns, only thrown Weapons will have any effect on the Training Construct. Sword Beams from the Master Sword will not affect it, nor will attacks from Bows. Materials thrown at the Training Construct will simply disintegrate, and the lasting effects such as the Fire given off by Fire Fruits will not affect it.
When the Training Construct is struck with a thrown Weapon, the Mysterious Voice will congratulate Link and then warn him to watch the Enemy's movements. At this point, the Training Construct will begin moving from side to side atop the platform and continue to shoot at Link. When it is struck by a thrown Weapon for a second time, it will be defeated. The Voice will again speak and instruct Link to advance further into the Shrine as a portcullis near the end of the Shrine lifts.
A Rauru and Sonia Statue can be found at the end of Teniten Shrine. By interacting with the Terminal in front of the Statue, Link can receive a Light of Blessing to cleanse the corruption of Darkness from within him.

The Teniten Shrine can be found on the southwest side of Whistling Hill in Hyrule Field, near the entrance to the Whistling Hill Cave. It corresponds to the Netinet Lightroot in the Depths.

正如神秘的声音所警告的那样，只有投掷出去的武器才对训练构造有效。主之剑的光束不会对其产生影响，同样，箭也不起作用。将武器投入训练构造只会使其分解，此外，火果产生的火焰等持续效果也不会对其产生影响。

当训练构造被投掷的武器击中时，神秘的声音会祝贺林克并警告他注意敌人的动作。此时，训练构造会在平台上左右移动，继续向林克射击。再次被投掷的武器击中后，它将被击败。声音再次响起，指示林克进到神社的深处，因为在神社末端的一个闸门被打开了。

约希修神殿是一个简单的圣光之地，其唯一目的就是奖励链接成功到达。它只有一个通往空地的通道，只有一块石箱作为标记。

在约希修神殿的尽头，可以找到一个拉鲁和索尼娅的雕像。通过与雕像前的终端互动，链接可以获得“祝福之光”，从而净化内部的黑暗力量。

约希修神殿位于西尼克卢达区域，在一系列坍塌的佐奈遗迹之间（Squabble River 和 Popla Foothills 之间的区域）。它对应于深渊中的“Uisihcoj Lightroot”。

solution_en:
The Ishokin Shrine is a simple Shrine of Light with the sole purpose of rewarding Link for reaching it. It bears a lone pathway in a void marked only by a Stone Chest.
A Rauru and Sonia Statue can be found at the end of Ishokin Shrine. By interacting with the Terminal in front of the Statue, Link can receive a Light of Blessing to cleanse the corruption of Darkness from within him.

The Ishokin Shrine is located on Zokassa Ridge in the Faron Grasslands. It corresponds with the Nikohsi Lightroot in the Depths.
solution_zh:
伊什金神殿是一个简单的圣光之所，其唯一目的在于奖励林克到达这里。它只有一个通往空地的路径，只被一块石头箱子标记。

在伊什金神殿的尽头可以找到一个拉鲁和索尼亚的雕像。通过与雕像前的终端互动，林克可以获得“祝福之光”，以净化他内心的黑暗侵蚀。

伊什金神殿位于法隆草原中的佐卡萨山脊上。它与深渊中的尼科希光根对应。

solution_en:
The Sisuran Shrine is a simple Shrine of Light with the sole purpose of rewarding Link for reaching it. It bears a lone pathway in a void marked only by a Stone Chest.
A Rauru and Sonia Statue can be found at the end of Sisuran Shrine. By interacting with the Terminal in front of the Statue, Link can receive a Light of Blessing to cleanse the corruption of Darkness from within him.

The Sisuran Shrine can be found along Hebra East Summit North in the Hebra Mountains. It corresponds with the Narusis Lightroot in the Depths. The Shrine can only be reached after defeating a nearby Frost Talus and retrieving the Mysterious Crystal from it.
solution_zh:
西苏兰神殿是一个简单的光之圣堂，其唯一目的在于奖励链接到达这里。它只有一个通往空地的通道，只有一块石箱作为标记。

在西苏兰神殿的尽头，可以找到拉鲁和索尼娅的雕像。通过与雕像前方的终端互动，链接可以获得“祝福之光”，从而清除体内由黑暗造成的污染。

西苏兰神殿位于黑尔山脉东部峰北部的赫布拉地区。它对应于深渊中的纳鲁斯光根。只有击败附近的冰霜巨石并从其身上获取神秘水晶后，才能到达该神殿。

solution_en:
The Tenmaten Shrine is a simple Shrine of Light with the sole purpose of rewarding Link for reaching it. It bears a lone pathway in a void marked only by a Stone Chest.
A Rauru and Sonia Statue can be found at the end of Tenmaten Shrine. By interacting with the Terminal in front of the Statue, Link can receive a Light of Blessing to cleanse the corruption of Darkness from within him.

The Tenmaten Shrine is located within the Elma Knolls Well in the Great Hyrule Forest. It corresponds to the Netamnet Lightroot in the Depths. The Well's interior is covered in Darkness, which Link must navigate in order to reach the Shrine of Light.
solution_zh:
天馬神殿是一座简单的光明神殿，其唯一目的就是奖励链接到达此处。它只有一个通往虚空的道路，只有一块石箱作为标志。

在天馬神殿的尽头，可以找到拉鲁和索尼亚的雕像。通过与雕像前的终端互动，链接可以获得“祝福之光”，从而清除自身内心的黑暗腐蚀。
天馬神殿位于大赫魯爾森林中的艾瑪山谷泉水中。它对应于深渊中的奈塔姆之光根。泉水内部被黑暗覆盖，链接需要穿越其中才能到达光明神殿。

solution_en:
Jochi-ihiga Shrine is a simple Shrine of Light with the sole purpose of rewarding Link for reaching it. It bears a lone pathway in a void marked only by a Stone Chest.

A Rauru and Sonia Statue can be found at the end of Jochi-ihiga Shrine. By interacting with the Terminal in front of the Statue, Link can receive a Light of Blessing to cleanse the corruption of Darkness from within him.

Jochi-ihiga Shrine can be found at the base of the Akkala Falls in the Akkala Highlands. It corresponds to the Agihi-ihcoj Lightroot in the Depths.
In order to enter the Shrine, Link must first complete the Shrine Quest "Rock for Sale". This Quest requires Link to purchase a Mysterious Crystal from Hagie in Tarrey Town for 50 Rupees and return it to the site of the Shrine. Upon returning the Mysterious Crystal to the Shrine, the entrance will appear.
solution_zh:
焦基-伊希加神社是一个简单的圣殿，只有一个目的：奖励林克到达这里。它只有一条通往空地的道路，上面只有一个石箱。

在焦基-伊希加神殿的尽头，可以找到拉鲁和索尼亚的雕像。通过与雕像前的终端互动，林克可以获得“祝福之光”，从而去除他体内的黑暗腐蚀。

焦基-伊希加神社位于阿卡拉瀑布脚下，在阿卡拉高原。它与深渊中的阿吉-伊霍哲的光根相对应。
为了进入神殿，林克首先必须完成任务“石头出售”。这个任务要求林克从塔累镇的哈吉那里购买一个神秘水晶，花费50 rupies，然后将其带回神社所在地。返回神秘水晶后，入口将会显现。

solution_en: The Makasura Shrine can be found on a cliff overlooking Kakariko Village in West Necluda. It corresponds to the Arusakam Lightroot in the Depths.
solution_zh: 位于西耐克卢附近卡卡里科村旁边的悬崖上，与深渊中的阿鲁斯卡姆光根对应。

solution_en:
The Kyononis Shrine consists of three chambers. Its purpose is to teach and challenge Link's combat abilities with a Training Construct placed at the center of the middle chamber. If Link approaches the Training Construct, it will awaken and a portcullis will fall behind him, preventing him from leaving the Shrine until he completes a combat trial. A Mysterious Voice will then call to Link, telling him to follow its instructions. It teaches Link to perform Side Hop, Backflips, Perfect Guards, and Charged Attacks against the Training Construct. This Construct cannot be destroyed until Link is prompted to perform a Charged Attack. While Link is tasked with Side Hopping and Backflipping, he is required to strike the Training Construct with a melee Weapon, though this is not required to advance beyond the Perfect Guard test.
When Link completes the Charged Attack test, the Training Construct will be defeated. The Mysterious Voice will acknowledge his skill, opening all of the portcullises in the Shrine. A Rauru and Sonia Statue can be found in the rear chamber. By interacting with the Terminal in front of the Statue, Link can receive a Light of Blessing to cleanse the corruption of Darkness from within him.

The Kyononis Shrine is a Shrine of Light situated at the edge of the Central Square in the Hyrule Castle Town Ruins. It corresponds to the Sinonoyk Lightroot in the Depths.
solution_zh:
“基耶诺斯神殿由三个房间组成。 其目的是通过放置在中间房间中心的训练构造，来教授和考验林克的战斗能力。 如果林克接近训练构造，它会苏醒并落下栅栏，阻止他离开神殿，直到他完成一次战斗测试为止。 随后一个神秘的声音会呼唤林克，并指导他如何攻击该构造。 它让林克学会Side Hop、Backflips、Perfect Guards和Charged Attacks。 这个构造必须在林克进行Charged Attack之前无法被破坏。 在林克需要进行Side Hopping和Backflipping的过程中，他需要使用近战武器攻击训练构造，但即使如此也无法过 Perfect Guard 测试。
当林克完成 Charged Attack 考试后，训练构造将被击败。 神秘的声音肯定了他的能力，打开了神殿的所有栅栏。 在后方房间可以找到拉欧和索尼亚的雕像。 通过与前方雕像前的终端互动，林克可以获得一盏祝福之光，以净化他内心的黑暗。

基耶诺斯神殿是一个位于海亚鲁城堡旧城区中央广场边缘的神殿。 它对应于深渊中的“西诺伊克的光根”。

solution_en: The Timawak Shrine can be found on the edge of Goronbi Lake in Eldin Canyon, being situated on a cliff overlooking the Bedrock Bistro. It corresponds to the Kawamit Lightroot in the Depths.
solution_zh: 蒂玛瓦神殿位于埃尔德因峡谷的戈隆比湖畔，俯瞰着“Bedrock Bistro”。它与深渊中的卡瓦米特光根对应。

solution_en:
The entrance room to Jonsau Shrine features a pool with a structure above its center. Along the far wall, there is an entryway that is blocked by a portcullis. The pool's Water holds a spherical Float, and the structure above the pool bears a downward-facing Target Switch. This Target Switch can be activated by holding the Float below the Water with Ultrahand and releasing it to make use of the buoyant force, sending the Float into the Target Switch. Alternatively, the Target Switch can be activated with any strong force, such as being struck with a Bomb Flower. When activated, the Target Switch releases the portcullis, allowing entry into a hallway further into the Shrine.
This hallway leads to another room with its own pool and structure with a downward-facing Target Switch. In this pool, there is a buoyant Board that can be used to activate the Target Switch and release the portcullis in this room. Link is then able to advance to the final room.

In the final room, there is a more complex structure set in a pool. This structure features a rail extending from the Water upward to a square platform with a hole in the middle. A basket set along this rail sits above the hole but is blocked by a wooden Board. By using the spherical Float in this pool, Link can dislodge the Board and send the basket falling down the rail. Link can then use the Float in tandem with the basket to ascend the rail platform, or use Recall to return the basket to its former position while he sits inside. Atop this platform, Link is able to walk over the gate barring access to the end of the Shrine.

A Rauru and Sonia Statue can be found at the end of Jonsau Shrine. By interacting with the Terminal in front of the Statue, Link can receive a Light of Blessing to cleanse the corruption of Darkness from within him.

Jonsau Shrine can be found on Mercay Island in the Lanayru Wetlands. It corresponds to the Uasnoj Lightroot in the Depths.
solution_zh:
존스오 사원의入口房间内有一个池塘，池塘中心有一座结构。在较长的墙壁上，有一个入口被一个铁门隔断。池塘中的水包含一个球形的浮子，而池塘上方结构的下方有一个向下指向的开关。可以通过将浮子用Ultrahand抓住并释放来激活这个开关，利用浮力的作用让浮子进入开关。或者也可以通过强力（例如炸弹花）来激活开关。激活后，开关会打开铁门，进入到神殿深处的一条走廊。

这条走廊通向另一个房间，该房间也有一个池塘和向下指向的开关。在该池塘中有一个可以用来激活开关并打开铁门的浮板。链接随后可以进入最终房间。

在最终房间内，有一个更复杂的结构设置在一个池塘中。该结构包含一条从水向上延伸到中间有孔的正方形平台上的轨道。轨道上放置了一个篮子位于孔上方，但被一个木板挡住了。通过在池塘中使用球形浮子，链接可以移除木板并使篮子沿着轨道落下。链接可以使用浮子与篮子一起登上平台，或者使用Recall将篮子恢复到原来的位置，同时坐在里面。在平台上，链接可以跨过阻挡神殿末端的铁门。

在존스오 사원의尽头，可以看到Rauru和Sonia的雕像。通过与雕像前的终端互动，Link可以获得“祝福之光”，以净化他内心的黑暗。

존스오 사원은位于兰埃鲁湿地中的默凯岛上，与深处的Uasnoj Lightroot相对应。

solution_en:
The Shrine opens to a grand hallway with a staircase leading to a wide pool. Inside the pool, there is a spherical Float. If this Float is Fused onto any of Link's Equipment, it will be replaced after a brief period of time. On the opposite end of the pool, there is a craning pillar extending over the pool. Along the inside edge of this pillar, there is a vertical rail with a Stone Slab slotted onto it. This Stone Slab is held in place by a Rope at the end of the pillar's crane.

In order to proceed beyond this point, Link can detach the Stone Slab from the Rope by shooting it with an Arrow, causing the Slab to fall along the rail into the pool below. Then, Link can attach the Float to the Stone Slab, creating a bridge for Link to cross to the higher terrain. Alternatively, Link can bypass the Stone Slab and cross the pool by freezing the Water and creating sheets of Ice.

Beyond the first pool, there is a second pool beneath a high ledge. On the near side of the pool, there is a second Stone Slab attached to the pool's edge by a hinge. To advance, Link can carry the Float from the first pool and attach it to the underside of the hinged Slab, forcing it upward and creating a ramp to the elevated area. As before, the Float can be ignored if Link uses a sheet of Ice for footing beneath the grated portion of the ledge and Ascending onto it instead.

The hall turns to the right above the second pool, leading to a much larger, third pool. At the near end of the pool, there is a Fan placed on a circular pedestal, a loose Stone Slab, and two more Floats. With these materials, Link can create a makeshift fan-boat to cross the Water.

Across from the third pool, there is a massive Floor Switch that must be weighed down in order for the portcullis at the end of the Shrine to open. While Link is intended to use the weight of his makeshift boat to hold the Switch down, any sufficiently heavy combination of Objects will also work. With the Switch pressed, the portcullis will permanently open, allowing Link to reach the end of the Shrine.

A Rauru and Sonia Statue can be found at the end of Rasiwak Shrine. By interacting with the Terminal in front of the Statue, Link can receive a Light of Blessing to cleanse the corruption of Darkness from within him.

Rasiwak Shrine is located on the northern end of the North Akkala Beach along the Akkala Sea. It corresponds to the Kawisar Lightroot in the Depths.
solution_zh:
主神殿通往一个宽敞的走廊，走廊尽头有一座楼梯通向一个水池。水池中有一个漂浮物（Float）。如果将该漂浮物连接到Link的任何装备上，它会在一段时间后被替换。在水池对面的另一端，有一根伸向水池的柱子。在该柱子的内侧边缘，有一个垂直的轨道，上面有一块石板。这块石板由柱子的液压装置固定。

为了继续前进，Link可以通过射出一支箭击落石板，使其沿着轨道落入水池中。然后，Link可以将漂浮物连接到石板上，从而为Link创建一个桥梁。或者，Link可以选择绕过石板，通过冰冻水来横渡水池。

在第一个水池之后，有一个位于高处的水池。在该水池的靠近一端，有一块石板与水池边缘铰链相连。为了继续前进，Link可以从第一个水池中取出漂浮物并将其连接到铰链的下方，从而创建一个坡道到达高处。如前所述，如果Link使用冰面作为支撑，将漂浮物忽略，可以直接向上攀登。

走廊向右转，位于第二个水池上方，通往一个更大的第三个水池。在该水池的靠近一端，有一个放置在圆形底座上的风扇，一块松动的石板以及两个其他的漂浮物。有了这些材料，Link可以制造一个临时的风扇船，以横渡水池。

与第三个水池相对的一侧，有巨大的地板开关。该开关必须被压下才能打开主神殿末端的吊门。虽然，Link被设计用来用临时的船只的重量来按住开关，但任何足够重的物品组合也可以。按下开关后，吊门将永久打开，让Link到达主神殿的尽头。

Rauru和Sonia的雕像位于Rasiwak主神殿的末端。通过与前方的终端交互，Link可以获得“光明之赐”，以净化他内心的黑暗。

Rasiwak主神殿位于北阿卡拉海滩的北部，靠近阿卡拉海。它对应于深渊中的カワイス（Kawisar）光根。

solution_en:
The Kudanisar Shrine is composed of one gigantic room separated into segments. A river of Quicksand flows throughout the Shrine of Light, pushing to crushers made with Spikes. Boards can be found floating across the surface of the Quicksand, acting as platforms for Link to rest on as he crosses the river.
In the first segment, Link is caged in the entrance, and must cross over the gate to enter the rest of the Shrine. In the main portion, there are Vehicles made from Sleds, Steering Sticks, and Fans. Beyond the gate and directly across from the entrance, there is a raised platform that houses the end of the Shrine. However, it is barred by a portcullis controlled by a Concave Slot. On the opposite side of the platform from the Concave Slot, there is a Floor Switch and a Tilted Platform, which sits underneath a dispenser in the ceiling. By pressing the Floor Switch, the dispenser will drop an orb, which will immediately be pushed to the other side of the Shrine by the Tilted Platform. The orb lands inside a caged area guarded by Soldier Constructs.
This caged area can be entered by using Ascend while standing underneath the horizontal grates surrounding it. Inside, there is another Floor Switch that controls the portcullis to the chamber and two more Vehicles that Link can escape with. By returning the orb to the Concave Slot, Link can find a Statue of Rauru and Sonia. By interacting with the Terminal in front of the Statue, Link can receive a Light of Blessing to cleanse the corruption of Darkness from within him.

The Kudanisar Shrine is a Shrine of Light on the Surface. It is located near the entrance to Karusa Valley in the Gerudo Desert. It corresponds to the Rasinaduk Lightroot in the Gerudo Desert Depths.
solution_zh:
古丹尼萨神殿由一个巨大的房间组成，分为多个部分。在光之神殿内，有一个沙子河流，它将碎石碾推向前方。可以在沙子河面上找到浮板，作为链接过河时休息的平台。

在第一个部分，链接被困在入口处，必须穿过大门进入神殿的其他区域。在主要部分，有由雪橇、方向杆和风扇制成的车辆。在大门对面，入口的正前方有一座平台上，那里是神殿的结尾。但是，它被一个由凹槽控制的吊窗所阻挡。在凹槽的反面，有一个地板开关和一个倾斜平台，它们位于天花板上的一个发射器下方。通过按下地板开关，发射器会将一颗球投掷出去，并立即被倾斜平台推到神殿另一侧。该球落入由士兵构造守护的笼内区域。

可以通过在环绕它的水平格栅下站立时使用 “Ascend” 进入这个笼子区域。在里面，还有一个控制吊窗的地板开关以及两个可以供链接逃脱的车。通过将球投放到凹槽中，链接可以找到拉鲁和索尼亚的神像。通过与神像前的终端互动，链接可以获得净化自身黑暗之心的“光”。

古丹尼萨神殿是地表上的一个光之神殿。它位于格鲁多沙漠的卡鲁萨山谷入口附近。 它对应于格鲁多沙漠深处的拉辛杜克水晶根。

solution_en: The Joju-u-u Shrine is located on a large piece of Fallen Debris on Ubota Point in West Necluda, which overlooks Lakeside Stable. It corresponds to the U-u-ujoj Lightroot in the Depths.
solution_zh: 佐朱乌乌神社位于西内克鲁达的乌博塔点，俯瞰湖边马厩。它与深渊中的幽光根对应。

solution_en:
The Jiosin Shrine focuses heavily on the precise use of the Ultrahand ability to manipulate the orientation of Objects. The starting room consists of a short hallway with a pit separating the hallway from the door to the next room and another room to the left from the Shrine entrance separated by a fence. The door across the pit cannot be reached because of its height and distance from the hallway where Link stands. A large Stone Slab in the room behind the fence can be used to cross the gap; however, it will not fit through the door that Link entered from. Link must use Ultrahand and rotate the Stone Slab in a position so it will fit through the X-shaped hole in the fence to reach the first room. Standing on either short end side of the Stone Slab will line it up with the hole when Link rotates, without needing to rotate the Stone Slab at all. The Stone Slab can then be laid across the gap to reach the door.
The next area of the Shrine has two more fences separating rooms with large holes on either side. The room on the right side from the entry contains the large stone Block needed to progress. This Block appears as two cubes connected on the diagonal. Like in the previous room, the stone Block must be positioned using Ultrahand to fit through the hole in the fence. Standing at the back of the room and facing the fence, rotating the stone Block twice forward will allow it to be wiggled through the hole. However, rotating it two more times to the left will more cleanly line it up with the hole to fit through.
An optional Treasure Chest can be obtained after getting the stone Block through this first hole. If Ultrahand is kept active from the previous hole, rotating the stone Block four times to the left will line up the stone Block with the hole in the ground which Link can use to climb up to the Treasure Chest, which contains a Hasty Elixir.
The stone Block must be used a second time to reach the final room of the Jiosin Shrine, but it must first fit through another hole. Keeping the same rotation from the previous use of the stone Block through the hole, the following rotations will position the stone Block to fit through the fence: two right, two up, one left, two down. If the stone Block was used to reach the optional Treasure Chest, the order will instead be: two left, two up, one left, two down.
Finally, in the room across the fence, rotating the stone Block twice up, once right, twice up, then twice right will allow Link to place the stone Block against the raised platform and climb on top of it to reach the end of the Shrine.
A Rauru and Sonia Statue can be found at the end of Jiosin Shrine. By interacting with the Terminal in front of the Statue, Link can receive a Light of Blessing to cleanse the corruption of Darkness from within him.

The Jiosin Shrine is a Shrine of Light on the Surface. It is located just outside the Hyrule Field Chasm in Central Hyrule. It corresponds to the Nisoij Lightroot in the Depths.
solution_zh:
吉奥辛神庙主要利用“Ultrahand”能力精确控制物体方向。起始房间包含一条短过道，过道与下一间房间之间有一个洞口，同时还有一道围栏将神庙入口处的另一间房间分隔开来。由于洞口的距离和高度以及Link所处的位置，“过道”中的门无法被触及。位于围栏后方的巨大石板可以用来跨越空隙，但它无法通过Link进入的门。Link需要使用“Ultrahand”，将石板旋转到能够穿过围栏X形孔的位置，从而到达第一间房间。站在石板的两个短边上，在Link旋转时，石板会自动对准孔洞，无需额外移动；然后可以将石板横放在空隙上，到达门前。

神庙的下一个区域有两道围栏分隔着房间，每个房间都位于较大空隙的两侧。右侧房间包含所需的巨大石块，它由两个立方体 diagonally 连接而成。类似于之前的房间，需要使用“Ultrahand”将石块放置在能够通过围栏孔洞的位置。站在房间后方，面向围栏时，旋转石块两次朝前即可使其穿过空隙；但为了更好地对准，还需要再转动一次向左。

如果能先通过第一个孔洞获得石块，就可以在里面获得一个可选的宝箱。如果保持在前一个孔洞中“Ultrahand”的作用，将石块旋转四次向左，它将与地面上的孔洞对齐，Link就可以利用这块石头攀爬到宝箱，宝箱里包含“Hasty Elixir”。
要到达吉奥辛神庙的最终房间，必须再次使用石块穿过另一个孔洞。与之前使用石块通过第一个孔洞时的相同旋转方式，以下旋转将使石块能够穿过围栏：两次向右、两次向上、一次向左、两次向下。如果先用它到达可选宝箱，顺序则相反：两次向左、两次向上、一次向左、两次向下。

最后，在围栏对面的房间，先旋转石块两次向上、一次向右、然后两次向上、再两次向右，就能将石块放在抬高的平台上并爬上去，到达神庙的尽头。
“Rauru”和“Sonia”雕像位于吉奥辛神庙的尽头。通过与前方的终端互动，Link可以获得净化自身内黑暗腐化的“Light of Blessing”。

吉奥辛神庙是地表上的一个“光之圣”，它就在火晶区域外的海拉鲁野地的裂缝附近，中立地区的中央。 它对应着深渊中的 “Nisoij Lightroot”。

solution_en:
Gatanisis Shrine opens into a spacious chamber with a bottomless pit at the bottom. Opposite the entrance, there is a wide spring device that sits beneath a Target Switch on its right side. High above the left side of the spring device, there is a dispenser that releases a gigantic Iron Ball onto a ramp which rolls the Iron Ball along the length of the spring device. An extension of the floor leads to the left side of the spring device, granting Link access to the device, which has a small platform jutting from its side allowing Link to safely stand on it outside of the path of the Iron Ball.
In order for Link to hit the Target Switch with the Iron Ball, he must make timely use of the Ancient Power Recall on the spring device as the Iron Ball travels along it. With the Target Switch activated, a portcullis along the wall opposite the entrance will raise, granting Link access to the end of the Shrine.

A Rauru and Sonia Statue can be found at the end of Gatanisis Shrine. By interacting with the Terminal in front of the Statue, Link can receive a Light of Blessing to cleanse the corruption of Darkness from within him.

Gatanisis Shrine can be found on the eastern side of the Akkala Highlands, on a cliff that overlooks the Lanayru Sea west of Knuckel Island. It corresponds to the Sisinatag Lightroot in the Depths.

加塔尼斯神殿是一个宽敞的房间，底部有一个深渊。入口对面的墙上有一个宽大的弹簧装置，它位于一个目标开关的右侧下方。弹簧装置左上方有一个发射器，可以向斜坡释放一个巨大的铁球，让铁球沿着弹簧装置，滑到尽头。地板延伸到弹簧装置的左侧，让林克可以安全地站在铁球的轨道外。

为了让林克的铁球击中目标开关，他必须在铁球沿着弹簧装置移动的过程中，及时使用弹簧上的古老力量回溯功能。激活目标开关后，神殿入口对面的墙上的一扇吊门会打开，让林克进入神殿的尽头。

加塔尼斯神殿的角落里，可以找到拉鲁和索尼亚的雕像。与雕像前的终端交互，林克可以获得净化黑暗的“祝福之光”。

加塔尼斯神殿位于阿卡拉高原的东侧，位于海湾湖以西，靠近诺克尔岛。它与深渊中的“西辛纳特格根”相关。
